title: Outdoor Activities: Hiking
welcome_lead: Step into the outdoors — and pack the right kit.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: hiking, the country code, kit.
final_note: Plan the route, check the weather, tell someone.

concepts.def: Rules to follow in the countryside.

walkthroughs.body_html: Choose a route. Check distance, climb and weather. Tell someone where you're going and when you'll be back.
Take map and compass (don't rely only on phone), water, snacks, waterproof, hat and sun cream. Wear sturdy footwear.
Stick to paths, close gates, take litter home, keep dogs under control, leave nothing but footprints.

mcqs.q: What does the Country Code say?

options: The volume of blood in the heart at any moment.
Strength is for the upper body, power for the lower.
Volume of blood pumped by the heart per minute (stroke volume x heart rate).

mcqs.q: What is the difference between aerobic and muscular endurance?
options: They are different names for the same component.
Aerobic endurance is the cardiovascular system's ability to supply oxygen; muscular endurance is a muscle's ability to contract repeatedly without fatigue.
Strength is for the upper body, power for the lower.
Aerobic is for legs, muscular for arms.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between strength and power?
options: Aerobic is for legs, muscular for arms.
Strength is maximum force; power is force times speed of movement.
Strength is for the upper body, power for the lower.
